description: List, create, edit or delete named grids (frame grid formats), or load all named grids from another InDesign document (Named Grids panel: New Named Grid, Named Grid Options, Delete Named Grids, Load All Named Grids)

filePath.description: load: the InDesign document (.indd) to load named grids from

grid.description: create, update: grid format options (Named Grid Options); only the ones you pass change

characterAlignment.description: Alignment of small characters to the largest in the line

characterCountSize.description: Size of the character count display (points)

gridAlignment.description: What the text aligns to on the grid

gridView.description: View: grid, N/Z view, grid and N/Z view, or alignment view

name.description: create, update, delete: the named grid

replace.description: load: replace grids with the same name (otherwise they are skipped)

name: manage_named_grids
title: Manage Named Grids
